description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Ice], [Awoken Ice], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Diamond Gazer] to the user

description.name: Awoken Ice
description.text: Ice abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Ice abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Ice
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Ice damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Ice resistance +20%

description.name: Diamond Gazer
description.text: Grants [40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies after using a Ice ability

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack
